name: Leesburg (United States)
description: Quartered: red quarters at the upper hoist and lower fly bearing a chequered band of blue and yellow, and blue quarters bearing a white dogwood flower.
history: Leesburg is a town in and the county seat of Loudoun County, Virginia. The flag was adopted on 14 September 2008 (the winner of the town's 250th-anniversary flag design contest, unveiled at the anniversary celebration on 14 September 2008, according to Flags of the World citing the Loudoun Times).

features.role: chequered bands of blue and yellow on the red quarters
dogwood flowers on the blue quarters
